messages:
Samir: NimblePay support escalated — they asked whether our incident retention scope includes HSM access logs and KMS key usage events for the period 2026-03-01..2026-03-05. Need quick confirmation and whether we should proactively notify them. pinging @Jess and @Li.

Jess: Security: we need to confirm which plane: control plane audit logs vs HSM vendor logs. Our audit pipeline ingests control-plane KMS API events (kms:Encrypt/Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey) for 90 days. HSM hardware logs are vendor-managed and not ingested by default. For this customer, do they have on-prem HSM or cloud-managed?

Marta: Support: NimblePay has Dedicated with VPC + HSM integration via partner token — they asked specifically for "all access events to keys used for their tenant" to verify no exfil. They also requested timeline for notification if scope expanded.

Owen: Eng-sre: we can pull KMS api events from the audit-store S3 bucket for the date range. HSM vendor logs would require a vendor export request — I can open a ticket. Query to run:

```
aws s3api get-object --bucket redwood-audit-store --key audits/2026/03/01/kms_events.json /tmp/kms.json
jq '.events[] | select(.tenant_id=="nimblepay")' /tmp/kms.json > /tmp/nimble_kms.json
```

ETA for KMS extract ~2 hours. HSM vendor export 3-7 business days.

Samir: Are there any legal or privacy blockers to handing over KMS event rows to the customer? They want raw event rows.

Li: Legal: For Dedicated customers, KMS API events that are about their tenant are within scope to share, but we need to redact any customer-identifying fields belonging to other tenants, and scrub IP addresses that map to internal infra. Also we need an approved data access request signed by the customer DPO. If they want HSM vendor logs, vendor contract + export costs apply.

Jess: Security: Also confirm retention policy: we keep control-plane KMS events 90 days, but we snapshot certain forensic windows for 365 days when requested. Check if NimblePay had a snapshot request — not seeing one.

Marta: I can ask NimblePay for signed DPA + DPO approval and whether they want redacted rows vs full export. Draft notice to customer:

"Hi — we're able to provide KMS API event logs pertaining to your tenant for 2026-03-01…03-05 within 48 hours. HSM vendor logs require a vendor export (3–7 business days) and may have additional costs. Please confirm you have DPO approval for access and whether you require redaction."

Samir: Okay proceed with KMS extract. Owen please run the query and stage export to a secure share. Marta please chase the DPO signed request and include Li for legal review of the notice. Jess, flag if we should escalate to CISO if vendor logs suggest possible compromise.

Owen: Got it. Starting extract now. Will post S3 path when ready. audit-bot: export job queued (job id a2f9c).

audit-bot: export complete — s3://redwood-audit-exports/nimblepay/2109876543/kms_events_20260301-05.json (access limited to sec+support+legal for 72h)

Marta: Noted. I'm messaging NimblePay to ask for DPO sign-off + whether they want IPs redacted. Will post copy of the customer notice here once I have it.

Li: I'll prepare the legal release template and confirm redaction checklist. If customer signs, we can share within 48 hours from export availability.

Samir: Thanks everyone. I'll keep customer PM looped. :thumbsup:
